description: pkix-path/src/lib.rs:874-879 — validate_path_with_profile enforces 'Profile::policy() must set current_time_unix == now_unix' only via a debug_assert!, which is a no-op in release builds. A buggy Profile implementation that returns the wrong now_unix in the policy will silently cause validity checks to run against the wrong time. Fix: either (a) accept the Profile::policy() result and unconditionally overwrite policy.current_time_unix = now_unix after the call (trusting the caller's now_unix rather than the profile), or (b) replace the debug_assert with a hard check that returns Err in release builds.
title: Profile::policy contract enforced only by debug_assert
